messages:
alex: Heads up — we're bringing up the gpu-eu-west-3 cluster next week. I need an observability bootstrap run (logs/metrics/traces), dashboard stubs for GPU utilization + pod-level latency, and a small set of alerting templates. Who can own?
priya: I can take bootstrapping Prometheus + node exporter + nvidia-dcgm exporter. Will follow the usual helm chart but will reduce retention defaults for cost.
michael: I'll own logs (Loki/Promtail) + index templates and retention. Suggest 14d for infra logs, 30d for audit streams.
jen: I'll do Grafana dashboard provisioning (provisioning folder + JSON models) and wire up a basic GPU panel + pod_latency.
alex: Awesome. Need a validation checklist and a handoff to oncall after verification. Also call out network constraints for eu-west-3 (eg egress NAT / firewall rules) — infra will need port 9090/3100/9411 opened between prometheus -> exporters, loki -> ingesters, and tempo -> collectors.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: plan started for module=observability region=eu-west-3 (tf run id: tf-4772) :eyes:
sam: Quick cost note — DCGM exporter on every GPU host adds ~0.5-1% CPU; ok for our 8k replica profile but call it out for Dedicated customers. Suggest enabling sampling of traces at 10% by default.
priya: Helm values I'll use (short):
```
prometheus:
  retention: 7d
  scrape_interval: 15s
  remote_write: []
nodeExporter:
  enabled: true
nvidiaDcgmExporter:
  enabled: true
```
michael: Loki promtail snippet I'll drop in:
```
server:
  http_listen_port: 9080
clients:
  - url: http://loki-distributor.monitoring.svc.cluster.local:3100/loki/api/v1/push
positions:
  filename: /var/log/positions.yaml
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: kubernetes-pods
    pipeline_stages: []
```
jen: Grafana provisioning (grafana/provisioning/dashboards/gpu.json) will include a panel with `nvml_gpu_utilization` and `container_cpu_usage_seconds_total` normalized. I'll add a template var for node pool.
alex: For alerting, let's start with a small set: GPU OOM/internodes down, node exporter down, prometheus target dropout, Loki ingesters backpressure. Example PrometheusRule: 
```
- alert: PrometheusTargetDown
  expr: up{job=~"prometheus"} == 0
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: critical
  annotations:
    summary: "Prometheus target down in {{ $labels.instance }}"
```
priya: Also add a cost alert: `rate(prometheus_tsdb_head_samples_appended_total[5m]) > 1e6` as a noisy index growth detector (tune later).
michael: Validation steps I'll run after deploy:
- Confirm logs are arriving (count > 0) for kube-system
- Check loki index creation and retention config
- Ensure prom targets show `UP` for node/ndcgm/exporters
- Run `kubectl logs` cross-check for 3 recent pod logs
- Simulate a small pod that OOMs to validate alert firing

nina: On the networking side: make sure Service CIDRs are whitelisted in the VPC firewall. Tempo uses 9411 by default if using Jaeger format — allow traffic from app subnets to tempo-collector svc.
oncall: I'll take post-verify pager duty rotation for 48h after handoff.
alex: Great. I'll create the runbook doc entry and add these ownerships. Can you each paste final helm values and any index templates back here when done? Keep replies short.
priya: Will do. ETA: Tue EOD. Terraform plan looks clean locally.
michael: Loki index template I'll paste once reviewers ack, ETA Wed AM.
jen: Dashboard JSON + provisioning PR by Wed EOD.
alex: Tagging followups: @priya @michael @jen. Add code links in the runbook. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
